stops.name: Binntal
stops.detail: The Binntal Hut of the Delémont SAC section is situated by the historic road across the Albrun Pass, a half-hour below the pass height. The road to the hut leads through a moorland of national importance. The hut offers the normal standard of Alpine club huts with an evening meal, breakfast, snacks and dormitory rooms. A caretaker is in attendance at the hut from the end of June to the end of September.
